question: What participating systems had better results than ones authors submitted?

answer.free_form_answer:
For SLC task : Ituorp, ProperGander and YMJA  teams had better results.
For FLC task: newspeak and Antiganda teams had better results.

title: Neural Architectures for Fine-Grained Propaganda Detection in News
answer_rationale: The retrieved documents only provide information about the performance of the authors' own system (MIC-CIS) relative to other participants, stating that it ranked 3rd and 4th in FLC and SLC tasks respectively. There is no information provided about any other participating systems' results or whether any of them outperformed the authors' submissions.
